title: xi dats animation action
description: A clip put into a model DAT, and the 0x07 routine that plays it, so the server (entityAnimationPacket) or a cutscene (0x2C SetAction) can fire it by its tag. The clip comes from a glTF (resources.animation, imported as `xi anim import --add` does) or straight out of another DAT (source: a cutscene gesture bank's clip, its bytes copied under the new name). The build edits each target's own copy of the model: the install's (.base kept), the pivot folder's, and with `xi dats build --hd` the HD folder's own copy (FFXI_HD_DIR), keeping its HD bytes. A clip that replaces one the model already has gets no routine unless schedule says so: the model's own routines play it.

dat.description: The model DAT the clip goes into (ROM/3/59.DAT, a goblin).

animation.description: The clip's name in the model. A digit-less name is slot 0 (gbw -> gbw0).

The .gltf the clip is built from (an `xi anim export`, edited or authored): relative to the project file (what `dats prepare` writes), projects/resources, or the working folder; or absolute. Read where it is, not copied.

dat.description: The DAT holding the clip (ROM6/0/4.DAT, a cutscene gesture bank).

clip.description: The clip's name there. It must drive no joint past the model's skeleton.

template_anim.description: glTF source: the model clip whose rig translations and scales a new clip takes (default idl).

keep_routine_duration.description: A clip that replaces one the model has: don't grow the window of the routine that plays it.

fps.description: glTF source: keyframe sampling rate (default the template clip's).

skeleton_dat.description: glTF source into a DAT with no skeleton of its own: the model the glTF was exported on.

schedule.description: The routine that plays the clip: false for none. Left out: a routine tagged with the clip's name, for a new clip only.

tag.description: The tag the server or a cutscene fires (default the clip name).

loops.description: Times the clip plays, then holds its last frame; 0 loops until something else plays.

blend.description: Crossfade in and out of the clip, in frames (30 a second).

result.description: Recorded by dats build: per build target, each section it wrote (the clip, a routine) with the SHA-1 of its bytes — what undo and the next build put back.

retail.description: The untouched copy holds a section of this name, which undo puts back.

seeded.description: A pivot build made this copy from the install's; undo removes it once it is the install's again.

examples.description: Cutscene gesture wz60 on the goblin, fired as gbw0 (mob:entityAnimationPacket("gbw0")), played once
A clip edited from an xi anim export, on the goblin's rig
